subject: How to stop ctmm from automatically loading upon startup

messages.author: 0cb1ab1dff2bfeb6
messages.subject: How to stop ctmm from automatically loading upon startup
parts: I have a script that first uses commands from the OpenStreetMap package to create maps of location data, then the ctmm package to calculate home range sizes. The ctmm package interferes with OpenStreetMap, so I have to load ctmm after I run the OpenStreetMap code. The issue is that R keeps automatically loading ctmm as soon as I open the program. Once ctmm has automatically loaded, I can't successfully run my script without uninstalling ctmm so it won't automatically load again, and then close out of R before restarting it. Simply offloading the ctmm package won't work for some reason, I have to uninstall it every time it's automatically loaded. As per an online forum, I tried going to tools>global options>restore .RData into workspace at startup and unchecking this option, though the ctmm package continues to automatically load every time. Does anyone have any suggestions for how to prevent the ctmm package from automatically loading every time I open R? Thanks!

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: How to stop ctmm from automatically loading upon startup
parts:
Hi Jason,

After stopping R from saving & loading workspaces, you probably just needed to restart in a new workspace.

For packages with namespace collision, you can use package::function() to call functions from that package without loading the package. This will work as long as the package exports all of their user-facing functions, though sometimes package developers will forget to export basic methods like plot() in their namespace.

Best,
Chris
